_comment: What Wenna Tuller says (talking_vendor_npc.gd shape: greeting, shop_intro, ambient, secret (night), topics). Written by tools/place_lumora_standins.py once; edit freely.
greeting: Welcome to Ralph's Last Round. Mind the tankard on the end of the bar: nobody touches Ralph's.
What'll it be? Water's cheap, the tea's better.
ambient: Ralph always said the last round's on the house. Ralph's not paying anymore.
Bards play here when they pass through. Best sound in the Outskirts.
secret: The tankard? Ralph Tuller poured it the night he rode out to the south road. We leave it where he left it.

lines: My husband. He rode out one night and didn't come back. The tankard waits for him.
